description: Different hosts should receive the same provider-neutral routing hints for Kotlin extension, isolated unit, and deferred plan items.

lockedFields.reason: Every Kotlin plan item should receive an advisory execution hint.
Only the isolated new MoneyFormatter unit test is safe to assign independently.
Extending the existing calculator test requires reviewing current coverage.
Extension work needs both the Kotlin source and its existing test.
The bounded unit-test extension does not require broader repository reasoning.
Routing hints stay keyed to the stable plan item identifier.
A new isolated Java unit test with low maintenance cost can run independently.
The formatter is a bounded pure unit-test target.
A deferred DTO recommendation should be reviewed rather than implemented.
Deferred work is not an independent implementation assignment.
